reason: The first direct/BOS pilot used distinct but per-group rotated salts. Validate the intended fixed-secret-per-user boundary without prior groups warming the same candidate.
model: Local Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, vLLM 0.17.1, C0 on RTX 3090. Same four document prompts and 16-token complete responses.
salts: One random 256-bit A salt and one independent random 256-bit B salt per server start, fixed across all groups of that start. The experiment client holds both; B-only attacker features see neither A salt nor A telemetry. Same salt across starts is not required.
case_identity: Every group prepends a public `Case NNN` line to all four documents before tokenization. For indexes 000-035, each prompt has exactly 554 Qwen tokens and a different first 16-token block from every other group. This prevents prior target/probe cache entries under fixed salts from altering later groups. Warm and cold target requests retain the same document body; public case code differs across groups and is randomized with condition order. This introduces a content-change limitation.
matched_design: For each direct and BOS mode: development 8 warm/cold pairs and 2 A-absent controls; separate fresh backend holdout 16 pairs and 4 controls. Fixed case plans/seeds 202611032601 and 202611032602 as before, with new salts and engines. A always sends one equal-length preparation request, then waits 250 ms, then sends document A at +15 ms in both states. B sends documents A-D at +0/+10/+20/+30 ms using own fixed salt. BOS releases B's four responses as a full W4 block; A remains direct.
attacker: Reuse frozen B-only R2/T1/T2/RT definitions, StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression(C=1), and within-mode development-only training. Signed T1 AUC direction from development, matched warm/cold sign test on holdout. Proxy, backend and victim data only for integrity/mechanism.
decision: Treat separation as robust to persistent per-user salt only if B cache misses, A warm544/cold0, fixed-salt counts, equal prompt lengths, full BOS blocks, T1 AUC >=0.75 and at least 12/16 matched pairs in the prespecified direction in both direct and BOS holdouts. Otherwise report a validity boundary; do not tune case codes or schedule after test.
limits: Public case codes are an artificial way to isolate repeated trials under a fixed salt; each matched condition uses a different code. One scheduler setting/model and a tightly synchronized loopback application remain favorable to an attacker. No defense algorithm is evaluated.
